 JOIN PHARMA_DEMO.BIZ.MKT_DEF_DRIVER m ON m.PROD_NDC11 = r.PROD_NDC11 AND m.MKT_DEF='DRY_EYE' AND r.WK_END_DT BETWEEN m.EFF_FROM AND m.EFF_TO
 JOIN PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PRODUCT p ON p.PROD_NDC11 = r.PROD_NDC11)
SELECT 'Northstar Commercial PL1001' seg, SUM(IFF(BRAND_NM='LACRIVIA',TRX_QTY,0)) lac, SUM(TRX_QTY) mkt, lac/mkt share FROM rx WHERE PLAN_ID='PL1001'
UNION ALL SELECT 'Northstar Commercial East PL1039', SUM(IFF(BRAND_NM='LACRIVIA',TRX_QTY,0)), SUM(TRX_QTY), SUM(IFF(BRAND_NM='LACRIVIA',TRX_QTY,0))/SUM(TRX_QTY) FROM rx WHERE PLAN_ID='PL1039'
UNION ALL SELECT 'National Commercial channel', SUM(IFF(BRAND_NM='LACRIVIA',TRX_QTY,0)), SUM(TRX_QTY), SUM(IFF(BRAND_NM='LACRIVIA',TRX_QTY,0))/SUM(TRX_QTY) FROM rx WHERE CHNL_CD='C'
UNION ALL SELECT 'National total', SUM(IFF(BRAND_NM='LACRIVIA',TRX_QTY,0)), SUM(TRX_QTY), SUM(IFF(BRAND_NM='LACRIVIA',TRX_QTY,0))/SUM(TRX_QTY) FROM rx
UNION ALL SELECT 'window '||MIN(WK_END_DT)||' to '||MAX(WK_END_DT), NULL,NULL,NULL FROM wks

WITH c AS (
 SELECT c.PLAN_ID, s.CHNL_CD, c.ADJ_STAT
 FROM PHARMA_DEMO.RAW_3P.CLMLNS_ADJ c
 JOIN PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PRODUCT p ON p.PROD_NDC11 = c.PROD_NDC11
 LEFT JOIN PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PAYER_SPINE s ON s.PLAN_ID = c.PLAN_ID
 WHERE p.BRAND_NM='LACRIVIA' AND c.CLM_DT BETWEEN '2026-06-27' AND '2026-09-25')
SELECT seg, SUM(IFF(ADJ_STAT='P',1,0)) paid, SUM(IFF(ADJ_STAT='R',1,0)) rej, SUM(IFF(ADJ_STAT='V',1,0)) rev,
 paid/NULLIF(paid+rej,0) paid_rate
FROM (SELECT IFF(PLAN_ID='PL1001','Northstar Commercial PL1001', IFF(PLAN_ID='PL1039','Northstar Commercial East PL1039','other')) seg, ADJ_STAT FROM c
      UNION ALL SELECT 'National Commercial channel', ADJ_STAT FROM c WHERE CHNL_CD='C'
      UNION ALL SELECT 'National total', ADJ_STAT FROM c)
WHERE seg <> 'other' GROUP BY seg ORDER BY seg

SELECT c.REJ_RSN_CD, COUNT_IF(c.PLAN_ID='PL1001') nstar_rej, COUNT(*) natl_rej
FROM PHARMA_DEMO.RAW_3P.CLMLNS_ADJ c JOIN PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PRODUCT p ON p.PROD_NDC11=c.PROD_NDC11
WHERE p.BRAND_NM='LACRIVIA' AND c.ADJ_STAT='R' AND c.CLM_DT BETWEEN '2026-06-27' AND '2026-09-25'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC
